integrity: Uniform face classification and elementary collapses are proved mathematically. Exact full finite replay covers 7<=n<=18 and the exceptional n=6; finite checks alone do not prove the all-n theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only one distance-two chord in a cycle of at least six vertices. Six-vertex collapse is a complete finite certificate. The unchorded cycle sphere theorem is established prior literature; no arbitrary-chord or equivariance claim. No independent audit.
title: A sharp simple-homotopy stability threshold for triangle-chorded cycles
